The generated worksheet claims completion of all criteria, with no N/A deferrals. Thirteen actionable findings are retained, including unmet claimed criteria and the diagnosed ownership-ratchet CI regression. No local test/build commands were run. CI fast compile remained in progress when inspected; the decision rests on source defects, not pending CI.
Criterion walk (test commands below identify source evidence and were not executed):
ac03ba3f: unverified — AC1: classify_pr uses the landing state rather than independent review facts, masking unreviewed/rework PRs behind CI-FAILED; observe dates waits from local observations instead of pushes/verdicts. See F1-F2.
ac6ad1b8: unverified — AC2: scheduled scan discards landings/hosts, and foreign-host memory is never collected. See F3.
acd93c9f: unverified — AC3: successful due-job delivery suppresses future mail attempts even when mail delivery failed. Consolidation, ordinary dedup and dry-window escalation have source tests, but the failure path is incorrect. See F11.
aca50907: verified by source evidence — AC4: LandCommand::Stalls dispatches stalls::run; run and scan_and_route share observe; render and serde project the same Report. Added test: cargo test -p aida-cli-lib land::stalls::tests::the_json_report_and_the_table_carry_the_same_classification (not executed during review).
ac38cf37: verified by test-source evidence — AC5: added land::stalls::tests cover each class, policy thresholds, route dedup and dry-window escalation, including an I/O ledger/mail test. Runnable filter: cargo test -p aida-cli-lib land::stalls::tests (not executed during review). Production-loader regressions remain in findings.
ac0bdfe3: verified by source evidence — AC6: project substrate job, maintenance_schedule command allow-list and doctor dispatch invoke ordinary Rust classification/routing; due jobs and seat-addressed mail are vendor independent. No model or session-local monitor is introduced. New legacy liveness calls separately fail the ownership ratchet (F13).
ac2ed289: unverified — AC7: subcriteria 7a-7d are unverified for the production cases below; no deferrals were declared.
ac2ed289/7a: unverified — Approved-red detail collection starves later PRs; partial logs and mixed base/PR failures can produce incorrect rerun/no-rework advice. See F8-F10.
ac2ed289/7b: unverified — Recurrences on unapproved PRs and main failures rerun green between ticks are missed. See F4-F5.
ac2ed289/7c: unverified — Lane follow-up loader ignores routing evidence and queues. See F6.
ac2ed289/7d: unverified — Claim loader omits shared process-lock claims and silently ages out still-blocking shared claims. See F7.
ac605a0d: verified by configuration evidence — AC8: .aida/config.toml enables both throughput_guard and its 20m substrate job with project thresholds; Policy::default remains disabled per the advisor ruling.
